title: docs(release): define the versioning and compatibility policy
problem: There is no stated versioning or compatibility policy.
why: Consumers need to know what a minor or patch release may change.
context: The project is pre-1.0 with no releases.
scope: Document semantic versioning usage, breaking-change policy, and the tracked Stellar crate line
State how machine output and exit codes are treated as API
guidance: Be explicit that pre-1.0 minor releases may break.
acceptance: Policy documented and linked from README

title: ci(release): automate changelog generation
problem: The changelog is maintained manually and can drift from commits.
why: Automation keeps release notes consistent with merged work.
scope: Generate a changelog section per release from conventional commits
Keep human editing possible
guidance: Fail clearly if no releasable changes are found.
acceptance: Changelog generation is deterministic and reviewable
tests: Dry-run on a sample commit range
docs: Document the process in the release guide.

title: feat(release): prepare crates.io packaging
problem: Crates are not packaged for publication.
why: Cargo-native installation is the most convenient path for Rust users.
context: Workspace metadata exists; publish readiness does not.
scope: Ensure docs.rs-friendly metadata, feature flags, and versioning across crates
Add a publish dry-run to CI
guidance: Do not publish from this issue; prepare and dry-run only.
acceptance: `cargo publish --dry-run` succeeds for each crate in order
security: Publishing requires a scoped token; never commit it.

title: ci(release): generate an SBOM and artifact attestations
problem: Releases have no software bill of materials or provenance.
why: SBOMs and provenance support downstream supply-chain verification.
context: Release artifacts are a separate issue.
scope: Generate a CycloneDX SBOM per release and attach it
Add build provenance for binaries where supported
guidance: Attach artifacts to the release only after validation.
acceptance: SBOM attached to a release and documented
dod: Merged and produced for a release.

title: ci(release): add compatibility testing across toolchains
problem: Only one stable toolchain is tested.
why: Compatibility across the supported range must be verified.
context: An MSRV pin is a separate issue.
scope: Add a matrix across the pinned MSRV and current stable
Document supported toolchains
guidance: Keep the matrix small to control cost.
acceptance: Matrix job is green and documented

title: docs: add an RPC guide
problem: There is no guide explaining the RPC layer, sources, and error handling.
why: A focused guide is necessary for contributors to extend the RPC layer correctly.
context: RPC documentation is spread thin and incomplete.
scope: Explain supported methods, the Horizon/RPC distinction, endpoint policy, retries, and pagination
Document what is not supported
guidance: Keep it accurate to the implemented surface; mark planned items clearly.
acceptance: Guide linked from the docs index and README
security: Explain the network and endpoint security policy.

title: docs: add an XDR and SCVal guide
problem: The decoding and rendering behavior is undocumented for contributors.
why: Contributors need to understand the schema and limits before extending decoding.
context: The versioned schema is a separate issue.
scope: Document supported types, rendering rules, limits, and error behavior
State that the JSON shape is unstable until the schema lands
acceptance: Guides linked from the docs index

title: docs: add a contract inspection guide
problem: Contract inspection behavior and its limits are undocumented.
why: Users must understand what is confirmed versus inferred.
context: Contract inspection is a separate issue.
scope: Document WASM validation, spec extraction, storage inspection, and explicit limitations
Include a worked example with a fixture
acceptance: Guide linked from the docs index

title: docs: add a security rule authoring guide
problem: There is no guide for authoring analysis rules.
why: Rule quality depends on a documented process and evidence standard.
context: The rule engine is a separate issue.
scope: Document rule structure, evidence requirements, severity/confidence semantics, fixtures, and false-positive policy
Provide a template
guidance: Require reproducible evidence and forbid fabrication.

title: docs: add a configuration reference
problem: Once configuration exists, it will be undocumented.
context: The configuration system is a separate issue.
scope: Document every configuration key, environment variable, precedence, and validation rule
State the security constraints
guidance: Keep the reference generated from or checked against the code where possible.
acceptance: Reference linked from the docs index
security: Document that configuration never embeds secrets.
